title: Oberstown, Ardee, Shanlis, Co. Louth, A92CX31
seoTitle: Oberstown, Ardee, Shanlis, Co. Louth, A92CX31
description:
Fantastic 4 bedroom detached bungalow that provides extensive and well presented accommodation throughout. This private rural location, situated on a matured site gives you the opportunity for peace and quiet set amongst C. 0.48 acres of its own grounds. The property offers light filled rooms with excellent entertaining space extending to c. 165 sq.m. (1,776 sq.ft.). The local town of Ardee is only 5 minutes drive away and has a variety of supermarkets, restaurants and amenities. This property is ideally suited to anyone seeking to relocate to a fabulous rural setting yet close to all the amenities that Ardee, Dunleer (11 mins) & Collon (8 mins) have to offer. The M1 motorway is c. 15 minute’s drive from the property giving access to the Dublin-Belfast corridor. Viewing Is Highly Recommended.
